entry.title: Civilizational Interpretive Ratio: A Structural Framework
entry.summary: A foundational theoretical framework examining the structural relationship between the complexity of autonomous systems and human interpretive capacity. Version 1 is conceptual and does not claim empirical validation or formal mathematical operationalisation.
